title: Patch: every Stinkyscape (cards 91 to 178 and its tokens) card drawn as what it is: a scene of its own for each, richer the rarer
notes: The picture pass over Stinkyscape's later cards (#3330, on #3331's foundation). Each of the 103 entries of #3403's table, Stinkyscape #91 to #176 and their tokens with the tokens of the early cards it names, draws from a scene recipe of its own, from a brief per card, in Stinkyscape's deep-space look, base and Radiant (R3403000): a Common one clear subject in a simple setting, a Rare its props, an Epic a scene with a foreground, a middle and a background, a Legendary or Mythic every layer. Each humanoid Unit is a figure dressed as who it is, fourteen Units are drawn as a creature or a machine (the Wasp and the Hornet, Megabase, the Sack, the Golem, the four Asteroids, the Spice Tower, the two drones, Escort Protocol and Combat Subroutine), crews and rivals stand as figures, and the figure kit and four new scene-kit modules of space grow by the parts the briefs name. The Starship Pieces, the Drone Battleship's layers, Anomaly Found!, the Terminus tokens and Dice of Doom keep their pictures for the issues that draw them. All 103 entries clear their rarity's detail floor and leave the short list, whose cap falls to 129 (R3331001). How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Stinkyscape's later cards drawn as scenes
changes: Stinkyscape's later cards and their tokens now each show a scene of their own, more detailed the rarer they are: Units as the characters and machines they are, Spells as real places and moments.
